about: A house interior starts with the layout

A house involves more decisions than an apartment: the staircase and upper floor, windows facing several directions, access to the terrace, guest rooms, the boiler room and service spaces. It works best when the designer joins before construction — then sockets, lighting, ventilation and built-in furniture are planned from the start, with no rework.

Our projects include Hodos Villa (500 m², Kyiv), Petrivtsi House (320 m², architecture and interior in one project), Pidgirland (260 m², Kyiv region), Hoda Estate (180 m², the Carpathians) and House 150 with a pool and terrace.
A turnkey house in one pair of hands

If the house does not exist yet, we start with design: architecture, structure, engineering and interior in one project. Construction costs from $600 per m², a turnkey house with finishes from $1,100 per m². For an existing house — turnkey renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials).
After the renovation — furnishing from $250 per m² and landscape design from $50 per 100 m². One manager, one schedule, photo reports every 1–2 weeks.
How much house interior design costs

An interior design project costs from $30 per m², minimum $2,500. The rate depends on the area, the number of rooms and the scope of documentation. For a 250 m² house the base calculation is 250 m² × $30 for design and 250 m² × $550 for renovation. We quote the exact price after the brief; a phone consultation is free.

faq: How much does house interior design cost?
From $30 per m², minimum project fee $2,500. We quote the exact price after the brief — it depends on the area and project scope.
When is it best to order the design — before or after construction?
Ideally before the engineering works start. Then lighting, sockets, ventilation and built-in furniture are planned at once, with no rework.
Do you work from our architect's design?
Yes. We take the architect's drawings as a basis and develop the interior; if needed, we agree changes with the author.
Can we order the whole house turnkey?
Yes: design, construction from $600 per m², turnkey with finishes from $1,100 per m², furnishing and landscaping — by one team.
